question: Find the roots of the quadratic equation 5x² - 12x - 17 = 0
solution:
**Given:**

The quadratic equation is 5x² - 12x - 17 = 0

**Formula Used:**

Quadratic formula: x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) / 2a

**Calculation:**

Here, a = 5, b = -12, c = -17

Discriminant = b² - 4ac

⇒ Discriminant = (-12)² - 4 × 5 × (-17)

⇒ Discriminant = 144 + 340

⇒ Discriminant = 484

√(Discriminant) = √484 = 22

x = (-b ± √(Discriminant)) / 2a

⇒ x = (12 ± 22) / (2 × 5)

⇒ x = (12 + 22) / 10 and x = (12 - 22) / 10

⇒ x = 34 / 10 and x = -10 / 10

⇒ x = 17/5 and x = -1

**The roots of the quadratic equation are 17/5 and -1.**
